headline: Rogobete Calls for Horațiu Moldovan's Departure from CNAS: "The Same Thinking of Cuts, Packaged in a New Program"
summary: Romanian Health Minister Alexandru Rogobete attacked Horațiu Moldovan, president of the National Health Insurance House (CNAS). He accused him of promoting a funding model that could affect small hospitals.
why: CNAS is Romania's national health insurance fund, and its funding model determines how public money flows to hospitals and healthcare providers.

original_headline: Rogobete cere plecarea lui Horațiu Moldovan de la CNAS: „Aceeași gândire de tăieri, ambalată într-un program nou”
